messages:
Ben: Quick sync: LockBox wants to integrate SSO + SCIM + BYOK into our marketplace. Call tomorrow 2pm PT. Need owners for SCIM mapping, KMS wrap, HSM attestation, and marketplace copy.

Aria: I can take SCIM + SSO. Ask partner for SAML metadata (entityID/ACS) and a sample SCIM users payload. Do they require group filters?

Marcus: Security will handle BYOK/KMS and HSM checks. Requirements: partner public key (PEM), cert chain, allowed wrapping algos (prefer RSA-OAEP-256), HSM vendor + attestation. If no FIPS cert, provide compensating controls. We'll do a staging import test.

Nora: Legal: need embargo window and logo permissions. Also confirm if partner wants a pre-approved quote. I can draft an NDA addendum for SOC2 references; estimate 48 hours after NDA signed.

notify-bot: Onboarding checklist: https://internal/partners/lockbox/onboard 1 Please update SCIM/KMS/HSM fields.

Aria: Quick SCIM test curl for partner to validate:
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users -d '{"userName":"jyoung","emails":[{"value":"jyoung@lockbox.com"}]}'

Marcus: Rotation policy: keys must support non-breaking rewrap. We'll run: import -> wrap token -> rotate -> unwrap. Security sign-off ETA: 2-3 business days after artifacts received.

Ben: Timeline: canary on Dedicated in 7 days, marketplace tile targeted 3 weeks later. Post any blockers here before EOD. Thanks! :thumbsup:
